analysis.summary_en: OpenBot is a local-first desktop workspace for persistent AI teammates.
highlights: ~/.cursor — login and session history managed exclusively by the Cursor CLI.
~/.kimi (or $KIMISHAREDIR) — login and session history managed exclusively by the Kimi Code CLI.
~/.cline (or $CLINE_DIR) — login and session history managed exclusively by the Cline CLI.
~/.codex — login and thread history managed exclusively by Codex CLI.
